description_en: Queries the performance data of a specified cluster
description_zh: 查看目标集群的性能数据
name: DescribeDBClusterPerformance

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html operation to query the IDs of all clusters in a specified region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html接口查看目标地域下所有集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The names of the performance metrics to query, which are the keys of the monitored items. Separate multiple values with commas (,). For more information about the supported metrics, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的性能指标名称（监控项Key），多个值之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。支持查询的指标详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the time in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The end time must be later than the start time, and the time span between the start time and the end time cannot exceed two days
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。 查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，且开始时间和结束时间的时间间隔不能超过两天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html operation to query the regions and zones supported by AnalyticDB for MySQL, including region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

DBClusterId.description_en:
The ID of the cluster.
You can call the [DescribeDBClusters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html） operation to query the IDs of all clusters in a specified region
DBClusterId.description_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html）接口查看目标地域下所有集群的集群ID

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query. The time is in UTC and follows the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
EndTime.description_zh: 查询结束时间。UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ

Performances.description_en: The list of cluster performance metrics

Key.description_en: The name of the performance metrics

Name.description_en: The name of the performance metrics (the value name of the monitoring metrics). For details, see [Overview of monitoring metrics]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html）
Name.description_zh: 性能指标名称（监控指标Value Name）。详情请参见[监控项概览]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html）

TranslateKey.description_en: The key used for internationalization. You can ignore this parameter
TranslateKey.description_zh: 做国际化翻译的key，日常不需要关注

Values.description_en: The details of the performance values at different points in time
Values.description_zh: 不同时间点下的性能值详情

items.description_en: The details of the performance values at different points in time
items.description_zh: 不同时间点下的性能值详情

Unit.description_en: The unit of the monitoring metrics

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间。UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
